    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">SQL Server 2025数据库引擎新特性汇总</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 style="text-align: center;">SQL Server 2025数据库引擎新特性汇总</h1>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">预览功能（PREVIEW_FEATURES）</span></h3>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">启用 PREVIEW_FEATURES 数据库作用域配置，以测试和探索向量索引等预览功能。此设置允许您即使在 SQL Server 正式发布后，仍可使用部分预览功能。 通过此配置启用的功能将在未来的累积更新中正式可用。一旦某个功能通过累积更新正式可用，该功能将不再需要 PREVIEW_FEATURES 配置。 这些功能仅供开发或测试使用，不建议在生产环境中使用。</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>USE&nbsp;HellasGateV2
GO
SELECT&nbsp;*&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;sys.database_scoped_configurations
WHERE&nbsp;[name]&nbsp;=&nbsp;'PREVIEW_FEATURES'
GO
ALTER&nbsp;DATABASE&nbsp;SCOPED&nbsp;CONFIGURATION
SET&nbsp;PREVIEW_FEATURES&nbsp;=&nbsp;ON;
GO</code></pre>
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">扩展事件会话加入时间限制选项</span></h3>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
说明
</li>


</ul>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">带 MAX_DURATION 的自动停止 现在可以在创建或修改事件会话时指定 MAX_DURATION（以秒为单位），使其在设定时间后自动停止扩展事件会话。</p>



</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">资源管理 这有助于防止会话无限运行，避免消耗资源并生成过多诊断数据。</p>



</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">手动控制仍可用 可以随时使用<code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; height: auto; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">ALTER EVENT SESSION ... STATE = STOP</code>手动停止扩展事件会话。</p>



</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">灵活修改 可以使用<code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; height: auto; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">ALTER EVENT SESSION</code>更改或移除扩展事件会话的时间限制，但会话必须先停止扩展事件会话。</p>



</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">系统视图支持 <code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; height: auto; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">sys.server_event_sessions</code>视图包含max_duration列，显示扩展事件会话的持续时间（0 表示无限制）。</p>



</li>


</ol>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
示例
</li>


</ul>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>CREATE&nbsp;EVENT&nbsp;SESSION&nbsp;[TimeBoundSession]&nbsp;ON&nbsp;SERVER
ADD&nbsp;EVENT&nbsp;sqlserver.sql_statement_completed
WITH&nbsp;(MAX_DURATION&nbsp;=&nbsp;600,&nbsp;STARTUP_STATE&nbsp;=&nbsp;OFF);&nbsp;--&nbsp;(例如&nbsp;10分钟，单位秒)

ALTER&nbsp;EVENT&nbsp;SESSION&nbsp;[TimeBoundSession]&nbsp;ON&nbsp;SERVER
WITH&nbsp;(MAX_DURATION&nbsp;=&nbsp;1200);&nbsp;--&nbsp;修改为20分钟

ALTER&nbsp;EVENT&nbsp;SESSION&nbsp;[TimeBoundSession]&nbsp;ON&nbsp;SERVER
WITH&nbsp;(MAX_DURATION&nbsp;=&nbsp;UNLIMITED);

ALTER&nbsp;EVENT&nbsp;SESSION&nbsp;[TimeBoundSession]&nbsp;ON&nbsp;SERVER&nbsp;STATE&nbsp;=&nbsp;STOP;</code></pre>
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">优化的 sp_executesql存储过程</span></h3>
<h6 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none dotted; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span>概述（Overview）<span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></span><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></h6>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
串行编译（Serialized Compilation）
</li>


</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">启用后，sp_executesql 批处理会像存储过程一样编译 —— 仅一个会话进行编译，其他会话等待，减少冗余执行计划的生成。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="2" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
执行计划重用（Plan Reuse）
</li>


</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">首次编译后，其他会话会重用缓存的执行计划，而非自行编译，提升性能和缓存效率。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="3" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
编译锁机制（Compile Lock Mechanism）
</li>


</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">编译锁确保同一时间仅一个会话进行编译，防止相同批处理的并行编译。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="4" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
推荐设置（Recommended Settings）
</li>


</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">为获得最佳效果，若启用了自动更新统计信息，还应启用ASYNC_STATS_UPDATE_WAIT_AT_LOW_PRIORITY，以避免长时间等待和排他锁。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="5" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
使用 T-SQL 启用（Enable with T-SQL）
</li>


</ol>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>ALTER&nbsp;DATABASE&nbsp;SCOPED&nbsp;CONFIGURATION&nbsp;SET&nbsp;OPTIMIZED_SP_EXECUTESQL&nbsp;=&nbsp;ON;</code></pre>
<h6 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none dotted; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span>执行计划缓存（Plan Cache）<span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></span><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></h6>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>启用OPTIMIZED_SP_EXECUTESQL可对 SQL Server 2025 的执行计划缓存产生积极影响。</li>
</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">减少执行计划冗余（Reduced Plan Duplication） 相同的 sp_executesql 批处理（排除参数值）将仅编译一次并共享同一执行计划，最大程度减少执行计划缓存中的冗余条目。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="2" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>提升执行计划重用率（Improved Plan Reuse）</li>
</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">后续执行将重用已编译的执行计划，这可提升性能并减少编译期间的 CPU 使用率。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="3" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>串行编译（Serialized Compilation）</li>
</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">同一时间仅一个会话编译批处理，其他会话等待或重用执行计划 —— 这避免了同一逻辑的多次同时编译。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="4" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>降低缓存碎片（Lower Cache Fragmentation）</li>
</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">通过避免同一执行计划的多个版本，缓存保持更整洁、更高效。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="5" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>首次编译期间的潜在等待（Potential Waits During First Compilation）</li>
</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">会话在首次执行期间可能短暂等待编译锁，但这通常被长期的缓存收益所抵消。</p>
<h6 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none dotted; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span>内存使用（Memory Usage）<span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></span><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></h6>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">启用OPTIMIZED_SP_EXECUTESQL可通过改进执行计划的处理方式，对 SQL Server 2025 的内存使用产生积极影响。</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>内存使用优势如下</li>
</ul>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>更少的冗余执行计划（Fewer Duplicate Plans）</li>
<li>更整洁的执行计划缓存（Cleaner Plan Cache）</li>
<li>更低的编译开销（Lower Compilation Overhead）</li>
</ol>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>潜在注意问题</li>
</ul>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">初始编译锁等待（Initial Compile Lock Waits）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">执行计划缓存压力降低（Plan Cache Pressure Reduction）</p>
</li>
</ol><br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">ZSTD 数据库备份压缩算法</span></h3>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">更快而且更高效</p>



</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">与旧的 '<code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; height: auto; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">MS_XPRESS</code>' 算法相比，ZSTD 提供了更优的速度和压缩比。</p>



</li>
<li>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;">执行备份时使用指定的压缩算法</p>



</li>


</ol>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>BACKUP&nbsp;DATABASE&nbsp;[databasename]&nbsp;&nbsp;...&nbsp;WITH&nbsp;COMPRESSION&nbsp;(ALGORITHM&nbsp;=&nbsp;ZSTD)&nbsp;--&nbsp;备份语句，指定压缩算法为&nbsp;ZSTD</code></pre>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>服务器范围的默认设置</li>
</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">使用以下语句将 ZSTD 设置为所有备份的默认压缩算法：</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>
--&nbsp;压缩算法取值：0&nbsp;=&nbsp;MS_XPRESS（默认），1&nbsp;=&nbsp;无，2&nbsp;=&nbsp;XPRESS，3&nbsp;=&nbsp;ZSTD

EXEC&nbsp;sp_configure&nbsp;'backup&nbsp;compression&nbsp;algorithm',&nbsp;3;&nbsp;--&nbsp;配置备份压缩算法为&nbsp;ZSTD
RECONFIGURE;&nbsp;--&nbsp;使配置生效</code></pre>
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">内存优化（XTP）相关文件和文件组的移除</span></h3>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">现在可通过删除所有内存优化文件和文件组，完全移除内存优化OLTP的相关表和数据文件—— 这在早期版本中无法实现。</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
验证步骤
</li>


</ul>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
使用 <code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">sys.dm_db_xtp_undeploy_status </code>检查是否使用了内存优化表（deployment_state = 1 或 2）。
</li>


</ol>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>SELECT&nbsp;*
FROM&nbsp;sys.dm_db_xtp_undeploy_status;</code></pre>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="2" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>删除所有内存优化表相关对象</li>
</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">在移除数据文件之前，必须删除所有内存优化表、表类型和本机编译的存储过程。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="3" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>移除文件和文件组</li>
</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">使用 <code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">ALTER DATABASE ... REMOVE FILE 和 ALTER DATABASE ... REMOVE FILEGROUP </code>来删除最后一个文件和文件组。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="4" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>长时间运行的移除过程</li>
</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">如果移除停滞，执行 <code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">CHECKPOINT </code> 命令并监控 <code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">sys.dm_db_xtp_undeploy_status</code>视图以跟踪进度并解决事务日志截断问题。</p>
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">列存储索引的改进</span></h3>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
有序非聚集列存储索引
</li>


</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">通过保持<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">非聚集</strong>列存储索引数据的排序状态，提升了实时运营分析HTAP场景中的查询性能。适用于对运营数据频繁执行分析查询的场景。SQL Server 2022已经提供了有序<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">聚集</strong>列存储索引功能。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="2" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
有序列存储索引的联机创建 / 重建
</li>


</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">现在可在<code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">CREATE INDEX</code>或<code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">ALTER INDEX</code>语句的ORDER子句中使用<code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">ONLINE = ON</code>。即使是有序列存储索引，也能在索引创建或重建期间实现停机时间最小化。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="3" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
有序聚集列存储索引的排序质量改进
</li>


</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">在联机创建有序<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">聚集</strong>列存储索引时，SQL Server 现在使用TempDB数据库进行排序，而非内存排序。若<code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">MAXDOP = 1</code>，索引生成的列段将完全有序且无重叠，提升查询性能（通过列段消除）。虽然可能因TempDB数据库 的I/O 增加从而增加构建时间，但在多数场景下收益超过成本。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="4" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
收缩LOB页面的改进
</li>


</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">列存储索引使用LOB页面，<code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">DBCC SHRINKDATABASE</code>和<code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">DBCC SHRINKFILE</code>现在可移动列存储索引中的 LOB 数据页。这使得收缩操作在回收空间时更有效，此前版本中这一能力受限。</p>


<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">变更跟踪（change tracking）改进</span></h3>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
新清理策略
</li>


</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">为大型变更跟踪辅助表引入自适应浅度清理。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">以增量步骤运行，减少资源使用并提升可扩展性。</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
默认启用
</li>


</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">在 SQL Server 2025 中，自适应浅度清理默认启用。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">它取代了 SQL Server 2022 及更早版本中使用的旧深度清理方法。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">若要禁用自适应浅度清理，请全局启用trace flag跟踪标志 8273。</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
安全清理点
</li>


</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">清理基于由保留期和清理深度确定的安全点。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">有助于避免大型表上的长时间阻塞操作。</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
收益
</li>


</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">减少清理期间的 CPU 和 I/O 峰值。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">对于具有大型变更跟踪辅助表的环境更高效。</p>


<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">AlwaysOn可读辅助副本的持久化统计信息</span></h3>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
自动统计信息持久化
</li>


</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">可读辅助副本上创建的临时统计信息，现在会<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">自动持久化到主副本</strong>。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">一旦持久化，这些统计信息会在所有副本间同步，从而提升查询性能和一致性。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="2" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
无需跟踪标志
</li>


</ol>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">与 SQL Server 2022（需要跟踪标志 12606）不同，该功能在 SQL Server 2025 中<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">默认启用</strong>。 在 SQL Server 2025 中使用跟踪标志 12606 会<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">禁用该功能</strong>。</p>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="3" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
sys.stats 视图中的新字段
</li>


</ol>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
<code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">replica_role_id</code> 指示副本角色（1 = 主副本，2 = 辅助副本，依此类推）。
</li>
<li>
<code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">replica_role_desc</code> 描述副本角色。
</li>
<li>
<code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">replica_name</code> 创建统计信息的副本名称。
</li>


</ul>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="4" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
功能亮点
</li>


</ol>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
即使完成持久化，临时统计信息仍会保留在辅助副本上。
</li>
<li>
优化器会使用最佳可用的统计信息，无论其来源。
</li>
<li>
辅助副本仍可基于自身的数据视图刷新过期统计信息。
</li>


</ul>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="5" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
监控与故障排除
</li>


</ol>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
使用扩展事件（<code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">persisted_stats_operation</code>）监控持久化操作。
</li>
<li>常见错误消息包括：
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;">
<li>
9131：功能已禁用
</li>
<li>
9136：表/索引已删除
</li>
<li>
9139：统计信息过大无法发送
</li>


</ul>



</li>


</ul>


<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">对TempDB数据库启用加速数据库恢复</span></h3>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">现在可以对TempDB数据库启用加速数据库恢复功能</p>
<h5 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; <ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
事务<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">即时回滚</strong>
</li>
<li>
主动事务日志截断
</li>
<li>
有助于防止长时间事务回滚和 TempDB 事务日志空间耗尽（这类情况可能导致数据库停机）
</li>


</ul>
<h5 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; <p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">在早期版本中，即使采用最小日志记录，TempDB 中长时间运行或失败的事务（例如涉及临时表或表变量的事务）也可能会导致：</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
事务日志<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">高使用率</strong>
</li>
<li>
事务回滚<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">延迟</strong>
</li>
<li>
应用程序<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">中断</strong>
</li>


</ul>
<h5 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%;
