transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none dashed; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span>示例代码<span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></span><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></h5>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>--&nbsp;启用&nbsp;tempdb&nbsp;的加速数据库恢复
ALTER&nbsp;DATABASE&nbsp;[tempdb]
SET&nbsp;ACCELERATED_DATABASE_RECOVERY&nbsp;=&nbsp;ON;

--&nbsp;验证&nbsp;tempdb数据库是否启用了加速数据库恢复（ADR）
SELECT&nbsp;name,
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;is_accelerated_database_recovery_on
FROM&nbsp;sys.databases
WHERE&nbsp;name&nbsp;=&nbsp;'tempdb';</code></pre>
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">TempDB数据库空间资源治理</span></h3>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
背景
</li>


</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">防止失控查询或工作负载消耗过多的 tempdb数据库空间。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">通过实施每个工作负载的限制，帮助提高可靠性并避免中断。</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
设置方式
</li>


</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">可以按工作负载组设置 tempdb 空间限制，方式如下：</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>GROUP_MAX_TEMPDB_DATA_MB&nbsp;--&nbsp;以&nbsp;MB&nbsp;为单位的固定大小。
GROUP_MAX_TEMPDB_DATA_PERCENT&nbsp;--&nbsp;占&nbsp;tempdb&nbsp;总大小的百分比。
--&nbsp;若两者都设置，固定限制优先。</code></pre>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>监控资源使用</li>
</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">sys.resource_governor_workload_groups</code>视图显示已配置的限制</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">sys.dm_resource_governor_workload_groups</code>视图显示当前和峰值的 tempdb 使用率</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">扩展事件：<code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">tempdb_data_workload_group_limit_reached</code> 当某个工作负载组超出其限制时触发</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>最佳实践</li>
</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">避免将限制设置得过低，尤其是默认工作负载组。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">如果工作负载不太可能同时达到峰值，可在多个组之间超额配置限制（例如，总限制超过 tempdb 的 100%）。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">预先设置好tempdb 数据文件大小和增长大小，并正确配置 <code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">MAXSIZE</code> 和 <code style="color: #009688; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">FILEGROWTH</code>，以使用基于百分比的限制。</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>限制</li>
</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">仅适用于tempdb数据文件，不适用于事务日志文件。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">版本存储的使用（例如，用于加速数据库恢复（ADR）的部分）不受治理。</p>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">空间按 8 KB 页跟踪，即使是部分使用的页也会被跟踪。</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>示例代码</li>
</ul>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">配置 tempdb 空间资源调控器</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>--&nbsp;启用资源调控器
ALTER&nbsp;RESOURCE&nbsp;GOVERNOR&nbsp;RECONFIGURE;
--&nbsp;创建资源池
CREATE&nbsp;RESOURCE&nbsp;POOL&nbsp;rg_tempdb_pool;
--&nbsp;创建带有&nbsp;tempdb&nbsp;空间限制（例如，500&nbsp;MB）的工作负载组
CREATE&nbsp;WORKLOAD&nbsp;GROUP&nbsp;wg_tempdb_group
USING&nbsp;rg_tempdb_pool
WITH&nbsp;(GROUP_MAX_TEMPDB_DATA_MB&nbsp;=&nbsp;500
&nbsp;&nbsp;--&nbsp;或使用&nbsp;GROUP_MAX_TEMPDB_DATA_PERCENT&nbsp;=&nbsp;10
);
--&nbsp;重新配置资源调控器
ALTER&nbsp;RESOURCE&nbsp;GOVERNOR&nbsp;RECONFIGURE;</code></pre>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">监控 tempdb 使用率</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>--&nbsp;监控&nbsp;tempdb&nbsp;使用情况
--&nbsp;按工作负载组查看当前&nbsp;tempdb&nbsp;使用情况
SELECT
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;wg.name&nbsp;AS&nbsp;工作负载组,
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;wg.group_id,
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;wg_stats.total_allocated_tempdb_kb&nbsp;/&nbsp;1024.0&nbsp;AS&nbsp;已使用TempDB_MB,
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;wg_stats.max_allocated_tempdb_kb&nbsp;/&nbsp;1024.0&nbsp;AS&nbsp;TempDB_MB_峰值
FROM&nbsp;sys.dm_resource_governor_workload_groups&nbsp;AS&nbsp;wg_stats
JOIN&nbsp;sys.resource_governor_workload_groups&nbsp;AS&nbsp;wg
ON&nbsp;wg_stats.group_id&nbsp;=&nbsp;wg.group_id;</code></pre>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">使用扩展事件监控限制违规</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>--&nbsp;使用扩展事件监控限制违规
CREATE&nbsp;EVENT&nbsp;SESSION&nbsp;[TempDBLimitMonitor]&nbsp;ON&nbsp;SERVER
ADD&nbsp;EVENT&nbsp;sqlserver.tempdb_data_workload_group_limit_reached
ADD&nbsp;TARGET&nbsp;package0.event_file
(
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SET&nbsp;filename&nbsp;=&nbsp;N'TempDBLimitMonitor.xel',
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;max_file_size&nbsp;=&nbsp;10,
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;max_rollover_files&nbsp;=&nbsp;5
)
WITH&nbsp;(STARTUP_STATE&nbsp;=&nbsp;ON);
GO</code></pre>
<br data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<h3 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 2px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none solid; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;">优化锁定</span></h3>
<h6 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none dotted; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span>什么是优化锁定<span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></span><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></h6>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
一种新的锁定机制，可减少锁内存使用、最小化阻塞并避免锁升级。
</li>
<li>
旨在为高吞吐量事务工作负载提升并发性和性能。
</li>


</ul>
<h6 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none dotted; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span>核心组成<span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></span><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></h6>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">事务ID锁</strong>
</li>


</ol>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
每一行的最后存储修改它的<code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">事务ID</code>。
</li>
<li>
不再持有大量行/页锁，而是持有一个单独的<code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">TID</code>锁，直到事务结束。
</li>
<li>
行/页锁在修改后立即释放。
</li>


</ul>
<ol style="list-style-type: decimal; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" start="2" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">限定后锁定</strong>
</li>


</ol>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>
使用最新提交的行版本评估谓词，而不获取锁。
</li>
<li>
仅在某行符合修改条件后才获取锁。
</li>
<li>
减少阻塞并提升并发性。
</li>


</ul>

width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span>启用优化锁定<span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></span><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></h6>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">示例代码</p>
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><code>ALTER&nbsp;DATABASE&nbsp;[YourDatabaseName]&nbsp;SET&nbsp;OPTIMIZED_LOCKING&nbsp;=&nbsp;ON;</code></pre>
<h6 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none dotted; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span>前提条件<span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></span><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></h6>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>数据库必须已经启用了<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">加速数据库恢复（ADR）</strong>。</li>
<li>为了充分获得<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">限定后锁定（LAQ）</strong>的优势，数据库应打开<strong style="color: #009688; font-weight: bold; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; height: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-width: 3px; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 0px; margin: 0px;">读已提交快照（RCSI）</strong>隔离级别
<pre class="custom highlighter-hljs"><code>ALTER&nbsp;DATABASE&nbsp;[你的数据库名]&nbsp;SET&nbsp;READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT&nbsp;ON;</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<h6 style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 30px 0px 15px 0px; border: 1px none #000000;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span><span class="content" style="font-size: 16px; color: #222222; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; border-width: 1px; border-color: #000000 #000000 #000000 #009688; border-style: none none none dotted; padding: 0px 0px 0px 10px; margin: 0px;"><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span>监控<span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></span><span style="align-items: unset; background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: unset; background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; border-top-left-radius: 0px; border-top-right-radius: 0px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0px; border-bottom-right-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; color: #000000; display: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; letter-spacing: 0px; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0em; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; border: 1px none #000000;">unset</span></h6>
<p style="color: #000000; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0em; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0em; padding: 8px 0px 8px 0px; margin: 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">开启了优化锁定之后，使用下面手段监控锁的情况</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; color: #000000; padding: 0px 0px 0px 25px; margin: 8px 0px 8px 0px;" data-tool="mdnice编辑器">
<li>使用 <code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">sys.dm_tran_locks</code> 视图观察锁行为。</li>
<li>新增的等待类型：<code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">LCK_M_S_XACT_READ</code>、<code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">LCK_M_S_XACT_MODIFY</code>。</li>
<li>扩展事件 <code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">lock_after_qual_stmt_abort</code> 当 LAQ（限定后锁定）被中止并重试时触发。</li>
<li>扩展事件 <code style="background-attachment: scroll; background-clip: border-box; background-color: rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); background-image: none; background-origin: padding-box; background-position-x: 0%; background-position-y: 0%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto; width: auto; border-top-left-radius: 4px; border-top-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: 'Operator Mono', Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; border-width: 3px; border-color: #000000 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-style: none; padding: 2px 4px 2px 4px; margin: 0px 2px 0px 2px;">locking_stats</code> 锁使用情况和 LAQ/TID 活动的定期汇总。</li>
</ul>
